description: Record action execution results, movement deltas, property changes, entity destruction, or spool outcome ingestion from 60Hz loop. Not for vision ingest or manual pose edits. Mark entity destroyed via status: "destroyed". Returns {ok, action, success:boolean, ...}. Use record_outcome instead of update_entity when applying executed action results and status deltas rather than hand-authoring entities.

action.description: Action type: "record" (default) for single outcome or "from_tick" for 60Hz batch spool ingestion

action_name.description: Name of the executed action (e.g. move_to, pickup, place, destroy)

destroyed.description: If true, marks entity as destroyed

resulting_position.description: New position of entity after action

resulting_velocity.description: New velocity vector of entity after action

spooled_outcomes.description: Batch of spooled outcomes to ingest from 60Hz loop off-tick execution

name: record_outcome
